## More Than Healthcare

Acibadem is far more than a group of hospitals. It is a fully integrated healthcare ecosystem —
bringing together a leading medical university, dedicated research institutes, advanced diagnostic
laboratories, pioneering digital-health platforms and specialised sports-medicine expertise. Every
element works in concert, so that each international patient benefits from shared knowledge,
continuous innovation and genuinely compassionate care, delivered to one consistent standard across
the entire network.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## We are board-certified vascular specialists dedicated to treatment of the body’s arteries and
## veins.

Whether you need treatment for a chronic vascular condition or you just want your legs to look their
very best, our team of experts is here to help.

## **Did You Know?**

### At Vascular Specialists of Central Florida, our vascular specialists, clinical staff and
### administrative staff are highly trained and able to assist you throughout every aspect of your
### vascular care.

# ** Always Wanted**

Sclerotherapy is the procedure used to treat unwanted small vessels,
called spider veins, usually found on the thighs and calves.

[Learn More About Sclerotherapy][44]
[Talking to patient][Talking to patient]

# **A 15 Minute Screening**** Could Save Your Life**

Early vascular disease detection can significantly reduce the risks of subsequent disability and
death from vascular disease.

[View Screening Packages][45]

[[Vascular 30Y ear GoldLogo][Vascular 30Y ear GoldLogo]][46]Vascular Specialists of Central Florida
(VSCF), Inc. is a single specialty group of Vascular Specialists, solely dedicated to the treatment
of the body’s arteries and veins. We strive to serve our patients as unique human beings, providing
them with the highest quality care in vascular health. We specialize in vascular surgery, vascular
medicine, endovascular surgery, and vascular imaging.

[Call Us][47] [Contact Us][48]

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We
endeavor to provide by far and liberally accessible belvedere to researchers and practitioners in
support of their novel and valuable ideas. We already have 2000+ [Editorial Board][73] members along
with 5000+ [Published articles][74] in our box. Our BJSTR maintains a scrupulous, methodical, fair
[peer review process][75]. Besides, quality control is riveted in each step of the publication
process.

#### Aim & Scope

We aim to frame tremendous standard international academic journals and strive to provide a
congenial and candidly attainable podium for researchers all over the world to present their
research victories and to reciprocate their ideas.

[  Read More ][76]

#### What do we do?

The BJSTR is an open access medical and clinical research publication that gives acclaimed
scientific authors and research experts a global platform to share their work among like-minded
peers and help accumulate scientific knowledge in a singular repository.

[  Read More ][77]

#### Why publish with us?

Our production process follows a high standard to ensure quality publications. All manuscripts are
endured to high level terminology compilation and bursting amendments, as well as being processed
through QC progressions, to ensure trustworthiness.

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We
endeavor to provide by far and liberally accessible belvedere to researchers and practitioners in
support of their novel and valuable ideas. We already have 2000+ [Editorial Board][73] members along
with 5000+ [Published articles][74] in our box. Our BJSTR maintains a scrupulous, methodical, fair
[peer review process][75]. Besides, quality control is riveted in each step of the publication
process.

#### Aim & Scope

We aim to frame tremendous standard international academic journals and strive to provide a
congenial and candidly attainable podium for researchers all over the world to present their
research victories and to reciprocate their ideas.

[  Read More ][76]

#### What do we do?

The BJSTR is an open access medical and clinical research publication that gives acclaimed
scientific authors and research experts a global platform to share their work among like-minded
peers and help accumulate scientific knowledge in a singular repository.

[  Read More ][77]

#### Why publish with us?

Our production process follows a high standard to ensure quality publications. All manuscripts are
endured to high level terminology compilation and bursting amendments, as well as being processed
through QC progressions, to ensure trustworthiness.

## [ Pre-Clinical Imaging Agents ][14]

BioPAL is a leading provider of quality MRI contrast reagents to the life-science community. We
offer a wide range of iron-base (T2 imaging agent, USPIOs) and gadolinium-based (T1 imaging agent)
contrast reagents. BioPAL also provides and developes products for other imaging systems, such as
optical (near infrared), nuclear imaging and CT.

## [ Kidney Diagnostics ][15]

Immunoassay kits to measure glomerular filtration rate (GFR) and to measure effective renal blood
flow (RBF). FIT-GFR kits are available to measure the clearance of inulin, iohexol, Gd-DTPA or
Gd-DOTA. FIT-RBF kit is available to measure the clearance of iodohippurate.

## [ Microspheres for Blood Flow Studies ][16]

BioPAL offers stable-isotope labeled microspheres, which is a cost-effective alternative to the use
of radioactive and optical microspheres for the measurement of regional organ blood flow and
particle deposition studies. Twelve different labels of microspheres are available.

## [ Dead-Cell Removal Kits - Viahance™ ][17]

Viahance dead-cell removal kit is the ONLY product on the market that can simultaneously remove dead
cells, stripped nuclei and free oligonucleotides from cell culture. This product is also the ONLY
product on the market that is provided autoclaved and does not contain foreign proteins, such as
Annexin-V.

## [ Products for Cellular Therapy Research ][18]

Innovative life science products to aid researchers developing novel cellular-based products to
study and treat disease. Dead cell and nucleic acid purification product for cell culture
preparations and ready-to-use cell labeling and tracking products for the evaluation of cell
delivery and retention.

#### Stem cell labeling imaging and tracking using MRI and magnetic retention for stem cells.

### [ Inulin and Iohexol ELISA Kits ][19]

FIT-GFR kits a designed to measure the clearance of inulin or iohexol to evaluate kidney function.

[inulin elisa kit to measure GFR and kidney function]

### [ Cell Labeling and Tracking ][20]

The best and most widely published MRI cell labeling and tracking product on the market.

[USPIO labeled cells for MRI tracking]

### [ Cell Culture Purification Product ][21]

A simple procedure for the removal of dead cells.

[Dead cell purification product]

2 million people in the United States.

[ [Heart to Heart] ][82]

## [ Heart to Heart ][83]

There are arrhythmias, and then there are arrhythmias.  Dr. Jim W. Cheung is currently at the
forefront of studying a serious arrhythmia known as short-coupled torsade de pointes or PMVT
(polymorphic ventricular tachycardia), which can lead to sudden death.

# Meet Christie Medical

Christie Medical Holdings, Inc. is a global company based in central Florida. A dedicated
trailblazer to Illuminating Revolutionary Patient Care™, Christie Medical proudly creates and
commercializes products for the healthcare industry. Its high-standing reputation has stood the test
of time, because Christie has been recognized as a MedTech Development Company of the Year (USA)
many times and VeinViewer® was voted **“[Best Mobile Vascular Imaging System][48]” by Global Health
& Pharma**.

*Christie is behind medical innovations that have paved the way towards better vascular access and
an improved patient experience. With the future always in mind, Christie is continually creating new
products and developing their existing ones through extensive research. **Learn more about
VeinViewer^{®} [Vision2][49] and [Flex][50]. ***

# Christie Medical is committed to
* #### Improving the patient experience
* #### Lowering the cost of care
* #### Minimizing patient risk
* #### Developing quality products

[Best Vein Finder][51]

# A Background on NIR Vascular Imaging Technologies

Near-infrared vascular imaging technology was first discovered almost thirty years ago. Shortly
after, the earliest model of VeinViewer® was developed and later deemed one of Time Magazine’s “Most
Amazing Inventions of 2004.” While trying to devise a device to assist the visually impaired, the
original inventor realized VeinViewer could distinguish blood vessels from surrounding tissue.
Prototypes ensued with several iterations as technology advanced leading to today’s smart VeinViewer
models.

Six device generations later and a global footprint of 40+ countries and counting, the VeinViewer®
has been revolutionary to the patient and practitioner experience since it’s invention.

# Navigate with CathCompass

CathCompass™ uses the unparalleled NIR technology by VeinViewer® to illuminate patients’ veins with
a built- in color-coded, peripheral IV catheter sizing reference graphic. Exclusive to the
VeinViewer® Flex and Vision2 models, CathCompass™ supports clinicians in the pre-, during, and
post-procedure vascular evaluation process.

[Explore CathCompass][52]

Frequently asked questions.

## Frequently asked questions.

What is clinIQ?

clinIQ is a clinic operations platform that adds real-time patient flow management, digital
check-in, RTM billing automation, and pre-authorization tracking on top of your existing EHR. It is
not a replacement for your EHR — it is the operational layer your EHR was never built to provide.

How long does it take to go live?

Most clinics are fully operational within 3–5 business days. EHR connection is same-day for
supported systems. Staff training takes under two hours.

Will it work with my EHR?

clinIQ integrates with all major EHR systems including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Cerner,
NextGen, AdvancedMD, and Tebra. If yours is not on that list, ask us — we likely have a connector or
can build one.

What is RTM billing and how does clinIQ automate it?

Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) is a set of Medicare and commercial payer CPT codes
(98975–98981) that allow clinics to bill for monitoring patients between visits using connected
devices or apps. clinIQ identifies eligible patients, tracks compliance minutes automatically, and
routes billing codes to your billing team or clearinghouse.

What does RTM billing pay per patient?

Most clinics average $120–$150 per RTM-enrolled patient per month. A 50-patient RTM panel generates
approximately $6,000–$7,500 in additional monthly revenue — with minimal added staff workload.

How does the digital check-in work?

Patients receive an SMS or email before their appointment. They complete intake forms, insurance
verification, and consent on their smartphone — before they arrive. When they walk in, front desk
check-in takes under 60 seconds.

How does pre-authorization automation work?

clinIQ pulls procedure and payer data from your schedule, submits prior auth requests
electronically, and tracks approval status in a single dashboard. Denials trigger automatic appeal
workflows. You stop chasing approvals.

Is clinIQ HIPAA compliant?

Yes. clinIQ is built to HIPAA standards with end-to-end encryption, role-based access controls, and
a signed BAA for every clinic. All data is stored and transmitted within HIPAA-compliant
infrastructure.

How is clinIQ different from our EHR?

Your EHR is a medical record and billing system. clinIQ is an operations platform. EHRs track what
happened — clinIQ manages what is happening right now: who is waiting, who is with a provider, which
RTM patients are compliant this month, which prior auths are pending. These are different jobs.

What does clinIQ cost?

Pricing is based on clinic size and modules selected. Most clinics recover the full cost within the
first month through RTM billing alone. Request a demo and we will put together a specific ROI
projection for your patient volume.

Providing a peaceful and dignified experience for your cherished companions within the sanctuary of
home.

[505-615-2418][1]

Monday - Saturday

Please call, text or email

10 am - 5:30 pm

Servicing: Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, East Mountains, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Placitas, Bosque Farms,
Los Lunas, and Belen. *Travel fees may apply.

Services

### Private Cremation

$600 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia and the pet's ashes are returned.

### Communal Cremation

$525 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia but the pet's ashes are not returned.

### In-Home Euthanasia

$400 - At home burial: Includes a brief discussion with the veterinarian, a sedation cocktail (for
pain control, anxiety relief, and anesthesia), and euthanasia. Making a paw print and clipping a
lock of fur included. Frame included for paw print.

Taxes and possible travel fee may apply. Please call, text or email for more information.

Additional Services

### Pet Loss Support

We provide gentle guidance and resources to support you after a difficult loss.

### In-Home Ultrasound Imaging

Bring advanced diagnostic care directly to your pet in the comfort of home. Our in-home ultrasound
service provides a safe, convenient, and low-stress way to evaluate your pet's abdomen or heart
without the need to travel to a clinic. Sedation is also available if needed.

### Hospice & Quality-of-Life Evaluation

$200 – Includes an examination by the doctor, a thorough discussion about your pet’s quality of life
and what to expect as their condition progresses. You’ll also receive an email summary of the visit,
sent to you and your regular veterinarian. 50% of this payment can be used for follow-on services
within 7 days.

## In-home Ultrasound Imaging

Experience high-end diagnostic technology without leaving your house, ensuring a tranquil atmosphere
for your loved ones. Our on-site imaging provides deep medical insights while avoiding the anxiety
of clinical visits and transportation. Every session is finalized with a professional analysis from
board-certified specialists to ensure the highest standard of health evaluation for your animal
family members. For more information please visit

[https://www.ultrasoundpaws.com][3]

## Healing In Heartfelt Peace

Navigating the loss of a cherished companion is a journey that requires tender care. We provide
thoughtful resources and a compassionate network to guide you through grief with clinical dignity
and emotional peace.

Locally owned and operated

Circle is invaluable to our clinical practice. cvi42’s intuitive post-processing analysis for both
CT and CMR studies, easiness to communicate findings, great customer service and constant

Joao Cavalcante, MD Director

Cardiac MRI and Structural CT

Minneapolis Heart Institute Abbott Northwestern Hospital

[Joao Cavalcante, MD Director]

In a high-volume tertiary cardiac center, our goal is to deliver high-quality, accurate imaging
reports within a reasonable turn-around time. Circle Cardiovascular Imaging provides seamless image
post processing solutions across different scanning platforms for our fellows and consultants. Our
partnership with Circle extends beyond the clinical service and CMR training. cvi42 is the selected
application to support the many research studies managed by our CMR Research Core Facility.

Calvin Chin, MD PhD FESC FRCP

Deputy Director, Cardiac MRI

National Heart Centre Singapore Senior Consultant, National Heart Centre Singapore Assistant
Professor, Duke-NUS Medical School

[Calvin Chin, MD PhD FESC FRCP]

I have worked with Circle Cardiovascular Imaging for almost ten years - initially for research only.
Because of its speed, accuracy and optimized workflows, we have been using it clinically for about
four years now. Without cvi42 and report42 we would not be able to deliver our high volume CMR
service with over 12 consultants and many more trainees. But what is best about Circle is the
customer service and the drive for continuous improvements and innovation.

Joao Cavalcante, MD Director

Steffen Petersen, MD, DPHIL, MPH

Consultant Cardiologist; Barts Heart Centre Professor of Cardiovascular Medicine; Queen Mary
University of London

[Joao Cavalcante, MD Director]

We have been using cvi42 since the beta version of the product in 2008 and it has shaped the way we
work in CMR. Despite many innovative and technological advancements over the last decade, the
software kept its core simplicity that allows for a productive workflow. We are confident that cvi42
will continue to carry on its’ cutting edge reputation and deliver more value in our CMR exams.

Juliano L Fernandes, MD, PhD, MBA

Jose Michel Kalaf Research Institute Radiologia Clinica de Campinas Campinas, Brazil

[Juliano L Fernandes, MD, PhD, MBA]

As soon as you use Circle’s software, you’ll notice the completeness of the tools. The software is
comprehensive for simple, routine studies as well as for advanced, more complex research purposes.
The multi-vendor and “pathology tagging” capabilities help enhance presentations, education,
workshops and multi-centric reviewing of studies. The report tool is simple and allows a faster read
time per patient. Circle’s strongest asset, however, is their great customer support - they have
become the reference for CMR imaging today.

Arshid Azarine, MD, MS

Cardiovascular Imaging, Paris, Saint-Joseph Hospital

[Arshid Azarine, MD, MS ]

clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

### FAQs

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the OPD timings?

**The ****OPD**** timings are from 9.00 pm to 9.00 pm Monday to Saturday**

How do I schedule an appointment with a cardiologist?

You can schedule an appointment by calling our office directly, using our online booking system, or
contacting us by phone at No:**093219 07278**

Where does Dr. Amit Patil practice?

Dr. Amit Patil practices at two locations:
* Surana Sethia Hospital, Sion – Trombay Rd, Suman Nagar, Chembur, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400071
* Wockhardt Hospitals, Agripada, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400011

What treatments are available for heart disease?

Treatments can include lifestyle changes, medications, minimally invasive procedures like
angioplasty, Pacemaker, TAVI.

What is cardiology?

Cardiology is a branch of medicine that deals with the diagnosis and treatment of heart conditions
and diseases. Cardiologists are specialized doctors who focus on heart health.

What conditions do cardiologists treat?

Cardiologists treat a variety of heart-related conditions including coronary artery disease, heart
attacks, heart failure, arrhythmias, hypertension, and congenital heart defects.

What diagnostic tests do cardiologists perform? And is this available in your center ?

Common tests include electrocardiograms (ECG/EKG), echocardiograms, stress tests, Holter monitoring,
Angiography , and cardiac catheterization, among others. All above test are available in our
hospital centers.

What is an echocardiogram?

An echocardiogram is a test that uses ultrasound waves to create images of the heart, helping
doctors assess its structure and function.

What is a stress test?

A stress test evaluates how your heart works during physical activity. It can help diagnose
conditions like coronary artery disease or determine the effectiveness of treatments.

How can I manage my heart health at home?

Managing heart health includes maintaining a healthy diet, regular exercise, quitting smoking,
controlling blood pressure and cholesterol, and following your doctor’s advice.

What are the risk factors for heart disease?

Risk factors include high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, smoking, obesity, physical
inactivity, and a family history of heart disease.

How can I reduce my risk of heart disease?

You can reduce your risk by adopting a heart-healthy lifestyle, which includes eating a balanced
diet, exercising regularly, avoiding tobacco, and managing stress.

### FAQs

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the OPD timings?

**The ****OPD**** timings are from 9.00 pm to 9.00 pm Monday to Saturday**

How do I schedule an appointment with a cardiologist?

You can schedule an appointment by calling our office directly, using our online booking system, or
contacting us by phone at No:**093219 07278**

Where does Dr. Amit Patil practice?

Dr. Amit Patil practices at two locations:
* Surana Sethia Hospital, Sion – Trombay Rd, Suman Nagar, Chembur, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400071
* Wockhardt Hospitals, Agripada, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400011

What treatments are available for heart disease?

Treatments can include lifestyle changes, medications, minimally invasive procedures like
angioplasty, Pacemaker, TAVI.

What is cardiology?

Cardiology is a branch of medicine that deals with the diagnosis and treatment of heart conditions
and diseases. Cardiologists are specialized doctors who focus on heart health.

What conditions do cardiologists treat?

Cardiologists treat a variety of heart-related conditions including coronary artery disease, heart
attacks, heart failure, arrhythmias, hypertension, and congenital heart defects.

What diagnostic tests do cardiologists perform? And is this available in your center ?

Common tests include electrocardiograms (ECG/EKG), echocardiograms, stress tests, Holter monitoring,
Angiography , and cardiac catheterization, among others. All above test are available in our
hospital centers.

What is an echocardiogram?

An echocardiogram is a test that uses ultrasound waves to create images of the heart, helping
doctors assess its structure and function.

What is a stress test?

A stress test evaluates how your heart works during physical activity. It can help diagnose
conditions like coronary artery disease or determine the effectiveness of treatments.

How can I manage my heart health at home?

Managing heart health includes maintaining a healthy diet, regular exercise, quitting smoking,
controlling blood pressure and cholesterol, and following your doctor’s advice.

What are the risk factors for heart disease?

Risk factors include high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, smoking, obesity, physical
inactivity, and a family history of heart disease.

How can I reduce my risk of heart disease?

You can reduce your risk by adopting a heart-healthy lifestyle, which includes eating a balanced
diet, exercising regularly, avoiding tobacco, and managing stress.

partners in lifelong heart health. With state-of-the-art technology and a patient-centered approach,
our board-certified cardiologists provide expert care for a full spectrum of cardiovascular and
vascular conditions.

that blends clinical excellence with personalized attention. From preventive screenings to advanced
procedures, we tailor every treatment plan to your unique needs, goals, and lifestyle.

possible heart health outcomes.

**We proudly specialize in the diagnosis and management of:**

## Welcome to the Heart & Vascular Clinic

**Dedicated to Your Heart Health—Every Beat of the Way**

At Heart & Vascular Clinic, we are more than just a cardiology practice—we are your dedicated
partners in lifelong heart health. With state-of-the-art technology and a patient-centered approach,
our board-certified cardiologists provide expert care for a full spectrum of cardiovascular and
vascular conditions.

We proudly serve patients in Newark, Wilmington, and Middletown, DE, delivering compassionate care
that blends clinical excellence with personalized attention. From preventive screenings to advanced
procedures, we tailor every treatment plan to your unique needs, goals, and lifestyle.

What sets us apart is our commitment to **education, trust, and continuity of care**. We take the
time to explain your diagnosis, answer your questions, and support you every step of the way—from
your first consultation to long-term management.

Our goal is simple: to help you feel informed, confident, and supported while achieving the best
possible heart health outcomes.

## What We Treat

**We proudly specialize in the diagnosis and management of:**
* Coronary Artery Disease
* Heart Failure
* Valvular Heart Disease
* Cardiac Arrhythmias
* Peripheral Arterial Disease
* Venous Disorders

And many other cardiovascular conditions

[highest standard of cardiac and vascular care]

## Our Mission

To deliver the **highest standard of cardiac and vascular care**—with compassion, precision, and a
focus on long-term wellness. Your heart health is our priority, and every decision we make centers
around improving your quality of life.

technology.

Our IDPS workflow is scanner agnostic with options for local and cloud data solutions. IDPS was also
among our solutions that played a part in the FIRST IN THE WORLD – HIMSS DIAM Stage 7 Accreditation
for a major, cutting-edge medical campus. See how our image-based information environment can
transform your lab workflow.

[Get Started][38]

Our fast and powerful diagnostic viewer, is built to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) to
enhance reading workflow, to support diagnostic accuracy and to enrich the user experience.

Workflow software with patient-centered integrated worklist, enables physicians to view images and
documents from all departments. Optimized communication tools and screen sharing to support
telemedicine.

[Get Started][40]

devices. Patient consults, remote reading, clinical review; all are possible within a single
framework.

First-ever comprehensive in vivo imaging platform with auto-exposure, auto-laser, and auto-gain

Our **macro, meso, and micro-scale** in vivo imaging systems span the visible spectrum and SWIR,
delivering **unparalleled modularity, sensitivity, resolution**, and ease of use.

### Who are we?

At Numi Scan North London. We are one of the leading providers of private obstetrics ultrasound
scans in London. Offering outstanding customer care in our custom-built clinic where we have
partnered, the latest top of the range equipment within a luxury setting. Displaying your scan on
our 75inch LED TV so you can see every little detail in a comfortable, personal, and relaxed
non-clinical setting.

All of our sonographers are fully qualified and highly skilled in obstetrics ultrasound. With a
wealth of experience producing the highest standard of 2D, 3D, 4D and HD images. With one of our
sonographers even delivered his own two children via c-section. So, you can rest assured you are in
safe and very experienced hands.

Our clinic is ideally located near Muswell Hill Broadway and just minutes from the A406 easily
accessible from Barnet, Finchley, Golders Green, Arnos Grove, Wood Green, Hornsey, Oakwood,
Cockfosters, Highgate, Crouch end and much more of North and North West London. With free parking
directly outside the clinic as well as the surrounding roads.

At Numi Scan. We understand that pregnancy and the thought of giving birth can be a worrying and an
anxious time for not only mum, but your partner too.

So, contact us today for more information on our services and clinic. Or you can book your scan
online today, [Here][79].

### Who are we?

At Numi Scan North London. We are one of the leading providers of private obstetrics ultrasound
scans in London. Offering outstanding customer care in our custom-built clinic where we have
partnered, the latest top of the range equipment within a luxury setting. Displaying your scan on
our 75inch LED TV so you can see every little detail in a comfortable, personal, and relaxed
non-clinical setting.

All of our sonographers are fully qualified and highly skilled in obstetrics ultrasound. With a
wealth of experience producing the highest standard of 2D, 3D, 4D and HD images. With one of our
sonographers even delivered his own two children via c-section. So, you can rest assured you are in
safe and very experienced hands.

Our clinic is ideally located near Muswell Hill Broadway and just minutes from the A406 easily
accessible from Barnet, Finchley, Golders Green, Arnos Grove, Wood Green, Hornsey, Oakwood,
Cockfosters, Highgate, Crouch end and much more of North and North West London. With free parking
directly outside the clinic as well as the surrounding roads.

At Numi Scan. We understand that pregnancy and the thought of giving birth can be a worrying and an
anxious time for not only mum, but your partner too.

So, contact us today for more information on our services and clinic. Or you can book your scan
online today, [Here][79].

I had an excellent experience purchasing my ultrasound machine with Probo medical. Glenn was
incredibly knowledgeable and provided clear, detailed answers to all of my questions. He was timely
in responses and always pleasant and patient, ensuring that I felt confident in my decision. I truly
appreciated his professionalism and dedication to helping me find the perfect machine for my needs.
The entire process was smooth and stress-free, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with my purchase.

Russell has gone above and beyond what anyone has ever done for our dexa/bone density problems. He
is with his weight in gold. He has come up with ideas and solutions with a depth of knowledge and
understanding of both the medical and technical fields associated with the dexa scan.

Enrico Franchini, so good at working across time zones and with different communication styles to
achieve what we needed.

Our representative was Tim Maltby. I contacted Tim back in February to request a quote for an
[ultrasound probe][102]. He got back to me right away. When I reached out to him this month to
inquire if the probe was still in stock as we were ready to purchase, he was so generous in giving
us the original price quoted and worked with our administrative assistant to get the purchase done.
Fast and thoughtful service. Once the order had been placed, the probe arrived 2-3 days later which
was amazing.

This was our first experience with Probo and from the first phone call to final delivery and
payment, Joe Hicks was straightforward and open to helping the entire way.

This helped me feel more confident in being able to service the unit when needed.
– Rana H. Epiq Training Course

Great and informative course. Introduction to ultrasound is a major plus for someone with limited or
zero knowledge.
Tyler Y.

# **OPENNPI**

## National Provider Identifier (NPI) Database

Search

The **National Provider Identifier (NPI)** is a Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
(HIPAA) Administrative Simplification Standard. A NPI is a 10-position, intelligence-free numeric
identifier (10-digit number), which uniquely identifies a covered health care provider, issued by
the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Covered health care providers and all health
plans and health care clearing houses must use the NPIs in the administrative and financial
transactions adopted under HIPAA.

All individual HIPAA-covered health care providers (physicians, pharmacists, physician assistants,
midwives, nurse practitioners, nurse anesthetists, dentists, denturists, optometrists,
chiropractors, clinical social workers, professional counselors, physical therapists, occupational
therapists, pharmacy technicians, athletic trainers etc.) or organizations (hospitals, home health
care agencies, nursing homes, residential treatment centers, group practices, laboratories,
pharmacies, medical equipment companies, etc.) must obtain an NPI for use in all HIPAA standard
transactions.

[ SCMR Extra-Cardiac Findings Course ][60]
This course is a one-day, fully virtual educational initiative designed to provide a comprehensive
and practical overview of extracardiac findings encountered during cardiac imaging. While
cardiac-focused studies are primarily aimed at evaluating cardiovascular structures, a wide range of
incidental extracardiac findings may have significant clinical implications. This course aims to
systematically address these findings, emphasizing recognition, interpretation, reporting, and
appropriate clinical management.

[ SCMR Extra-Cardiac Findings Course ][60]
This course is a one-day, fully virtual educational initiative designed to provide a comprehensive
and practical overview of extracardiac findings encountered during cardiac imaging. While
cardiac-focused studies are primarily aimed at evaluating cardiovascular structures, a wide range of
incidental extracardiac findings may have significant clinical implications. This course aims to
systematically address these findings, emphasizing recognition, interpretation, reporting, and
appropriate clinical management.

offers, instant messengers for communication in one click, accounts in social networks and more.

**Allow your clients to connect with you with one click**

## A world without fear of cancer

Siemens Healthineers is focused on elevating cancer care across the entire patient journey. By
enhancing the patient experience, enabling more personalized care, streamlining clinical workflows,
and making innovation accessible, we help care teams to improve outcomes for **a world without fear
of cancer**.

## Elevating cancer care across the entire patient journey

See how a connected cancer care approach turns growing complexity into coordinated action and
confident care — for patients, families, and care teams.

We support theranostics as a service line by integrating hardware, software, and services – so teams
can build with confidence.

## **Laryngoscope Series**

**Founded in 2012** - Laid a solid foundation for cooperation in the medical industry.
**Strategic Transformation in 2015** - Transformed into a professional medical equipment
manufacturer, focusing on R&D of visual medical devices.
**Quality Leap in 2017** - Obtained ISO9001 and ISO13485 quality system certifications.
**International Recognition in 2018** - Acquired the registration certificate for anesthetic video
laryngoscopes.Obtained the import and export license, officially entering the global market.
**Innovation & Patents in 2020** - Laryngoscope blades were successfully registered.The company owns
more than 30 patents in total, including 3 invention patents.
**Global Certification in 2021** - Passed US FDA, EU CE and South Korea KGMP certifications.Started
the R&D of disposable endoscopes.
**Product Launch in 2022** - The video tracheal intubation scope completed registration and was
officially launched.
**High-tech Enterprise Accreditation in 2023** - Certified as a National High-tech Enterprise.
Retained the qualification of Technology-based Small and Medium-sized Enterprises for three
consecutive years.
**Specialized & Sophisticated Enterprise in 2024** - Completed registration of disposable urological
endoscopes and medical endoscope image processors. Applied for the Specialized, Refined,
Characteristic & Innovative Enterprise qualification.
**Product Expansion in 2025** - Completed registration of disposable bronchoscope catheters,
electronic bronchoscopes and electronic nasopharyngolaryngoscopes.
[learn more][45]

## **Ultrasonic Scalpel Series**

Our R&D team brings together a group of R&D and testing engineers with over 10 years of professional
experience in the medical device industry.

We have established sound R&D and testing management systems, which fundamentally guarantee the
safety, efficacy and reliability of our products.
Covering an area of 4,000 square meters, our manufacturing center is equipped with a Class 100,000
clean workshop, active device assembly workshop and core component production workshop, capable of
mass production of sterile medical products and active medical instruments.

In addition, we own a biochemical laboratory and a comprehensive quality inspection laboratory,
forming a complete production workflow and quality control system to ensure consistent and qualified
quality of all products.
[learn more][46]

## **Infusion Pump Series**

The company is mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of products
including blood transfusion & infusion warmer, medical warming blanket, special infusion stand,
vascular vein viewer, syringe pump, infusion pump, enteral nutrition pump, infusion information
acquisition system, and central monitoring management software.

The company has gathered a professional team of management, R&D, sales and after-sales talents in
the medical industry. It owns dozens of patented technologies and software copyrights. Some products
have passed EU CE certification. Our products are widely sold all over China and exported to Europe,
North and South America, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, Africa and other countries and regions,
enjoying high recognition and favorable comments from customers.

We strive to provide users with safe, reliable, technologically advanced and comfortable experienced
products and services. Going forward, we will join hands with partners to further advance the
development of the medical and health industry.
[learn more][47]
